allowed_changes: Explicit central administration submit handler in the shared browser asset
Central navigation entry on authenticated pages

product_review: Customer-facing MCP and Skill management with concise tool cards, responsive layout, and optional computer access.

browser_module_review.allowed_change: Bundled central browser modules. Replacing the bundle with the prior source exactly reproduces every previous page hash and byte count.

browser_lifecycle_review.allowed_change: Fence detached central browser workflows and require operation-specific receipts. DOM regressions cover late OAuth responses after navigation, malformed write receipts, refresh-required no-replay behavior and unchanged MCP/Skill product flows; no screenshots.

direct_connection_review.allowed_change: The saved service is rendered before OAuth handoff so a failed provider setup retains its visible recovery controls. The controller still owns lifecycle, shared admission and busy state. DOM regression verifies persisted service visibility and no automatic replay after failed handoff. No screenshots.

mcp_skill_presentation_review.allowed_change: Rename customer navigation to MCP and Skill; show tool names and descriptions as plain cards with a count. Remove repeated sharing explanations and parameter/schema dumps. DOM regressions retain automatic connection, OAuth recovery, Skill installation and safe text rendering. No screenshots.

tool_layout_review.allowed_change: Scope wrapping to the MCP tool panel heading so 64-character names remain visible on mobile; preserve upstream tool title casing. Removing only the two CSS rules reproduces every prior hash. Browser checks measure actual header bounds without screenshots.

library_content_layout_review.allowed_change: Wrap user-provided text within the MCP/Skill product surface, including Skill names, descriptions, file paths and installation status. Preserve original casing of all library card names. Reverting only these two CSS changes reproduces every prior hash. Valid Skill fixtures and DOM dimensions cover mobile and desktop without screenshots.

runner_action_review.allowed_change: Runner delete/revoke form feedback and scoped browser workflow. Failed actions retain the console; duplicate POSTs are blocked and uncertain writes are never replayed. Reversing only the reviewed form markup and bundle reproduces all prior hashes.

controller_review.reviewed_change: Separate locale, shared idempotent controls, page mounting and navigation from the composition entry. Preserve markup outside the script byte-for-byte. Public DOM and port-based regressions verify initial/dynamic controls, fresh navigation and Runner actions; no screenshots.

runner_action_deadline_review.reviewed_change: Bound Runner delete/revoke response headers and body reads with one 25-second deadline. Stalled-response browser regressions retain session and page, restore controls, and never replay writes. Replacing only the inline bundle reproduces every prior hash and byte count. No screenshots.

ui_copy_review.reviewed_change: Natural English and Chinese interface copy; remove duplicate warnings and developer terminology. Exact reviewed substitutions reproduce all 20 rendered cases. Installer commands, CSS blocks, protected user data, form actions and permission controls are unchanged. No screenshots.

browser_error_copy_review.reviewed_change: Localize native Skill file-read, UTF-8, network and malformed-response failures in English and Chinese. Browser regressions reject invalid files without requests and recover through reselection, preserving text. Uncertain writes still require refresh and are never replayed. All non-script markup remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No screenshots.

navigation_deadline_review.reviewed_change: Bound navigation response headers and body with one 25-second deadline. Full-page fallbacks preserve the latest queued destination without extra requests. Replacing only the inline bundle reproduces every prior hash and byte count. No screenshots.

skill_upload_review.reviewed_change: Raise Skill uploads to 256 files, 1 MiB per file and 8 MiB per canonical package. Form limits come from the server contract. Bilingual DOM tests cover actual folder selection, oversized selections, JSON escaping and retry after confirmed HTTP 413. No screenshots.

oauth_reconnect_review.reviewed_change: Reconnect reconciles saved profiles before beginning OAuth, recovers failed discovery without a manual refresh, and checks current enabled state and revision. Missing or invalid vault readiness gets a specific bilingual configuration error. Regression covers fresh revisions, failed reconciliation, concurrent pause and preserved account state. No screenshots.

oauth_discovery_review.reviewed_change: Represent an undiscovered catalog and pending authorization as explicit states. Reuse the initial catalog read during interrupted OAuth recovery. Browser regressions preserve reconnect guidance and publication checks. Replacing only the inline bundle reproduces every prior hash and byte count. No screenshots.

oauth_handoff_review.reviewed_change: User-triggered MCP discovery starts OAuth automatically when authorization is required. Reconnect preserves sign-in progress through internal refresh; callback recovery never starts a new authorization. Replacing only the browser bundle reproduces every prior render hash and byte count. No screenshots.

client_lifecycle_review.allowed_change: Shared revoke/delete forms on MCP client list and details, including central-only clients, plus the reviewed deletion confirmation script. Other renderers remain unchanged.

navigation_superseded_review.reviewed_change: Discard a superseded navigation response before mounting controllers or updating history. The final queued page owns its URL and content; existing failure and locale fallbacks are unchanged. Replacing only the inline bundle reproduces every prior hash and byte count. No screenshots.

navigation_layout_review.reviewed_change: Restore fragment focus and scrolling below the sticky header after soft navigation; move newly opened pages to their heading while preserving same-page refresh position. Let mounted pages use their content height instead of retaining the previous page height. Reset measured command-panel heights before resize. Reset the mobile enrollment action form flex basis. Describe OAuth recovery with direct next steps in both languages. Independently rebuilding and substituting only the prior bundle and style block reproduces every original hash and byte count.

client_layout_review.reviewed_change: Constrain client Runner selectors and long values to their table cells. Give recording preferences an independent single-column form. Replacing only the reviewed CSS and recording form class reproduces all 20 prior rendered hashes and byte counts.

permission_controls_review.reviewed_change: Permission selectors expose dependencies derived from the shared protocol and use one browser controller for Runner, workspace and client override forms. Workspace presets share the submitted-form definition and update displayed values; manual field edits choose Custom. Version guidance describes selecting a target, installing on the Runner host and restarting the service. Restoring only the previous bundle, dependency/preset attributes and version sentence reproduces every prior rendered hash and byte count.

clipboard_failure_review.reviewed_change: Report failed clipboard writes with short English and Chinese retry labels, keep manual-copy guidance in the button title, announce copy status with a polite live region, remove temporary clipboard content on every outcome, and allow explicit retry. Replacing only the new browser bundle with the independently rebuilt source-base bundle reproduces every prior rendered hash and byte count.

skill_capacity_review.reviewed_change: Confirmed Skill installation capacity rejections show a localized limit message and leave the form ready for an explicit next operation. Unknown outcomes and unrelated HTTP 429 errors retain refresh admission. Replacing only the updated browser bundle reproduces each previous rendered hash and byte count.

navigation_lifetime_review.reviewed_change: Retire page actions when navigation begins and inject the current-page guard into MCP and Runner controllers. Late OAuth and Runner responses preserve the chosen destination; discarded Runner responses release their unread body. Substituting the independently rebuilt prior browser bundle reproduces all 13 prior rendered hashes and byte counts and both script wrapper hashes.

full_navigation_handoff_review.reviewed_change: Route language, OAuth and Runner full-page destinations through the navigation owner. Native page departure retires controllers, aborts pending soft navigation and clears queued destinations. Independently rebuilding and substituting the prior browser bundle reproduces all 13 prior renderer hashes and byte counts and both script wrapper hashes.

fragment_navigation_review.reviewed_change: Preserve forms and controller lifetimes for settled same-page fragment history. Pending or cross-page restoration continues through the existing navigation owner. Independently rebuilding and substituting the prior browser bundle reproduces all 13 prior renderer hashes and byte counts and both script wrapper hashes.

oauth_navigation_review.reviewed_change: Route OAuth callback URL cleanup through the existing navigation and page-view owners so rendered page keys match native history. Same-page history preserves live forms; pending and cross-page navigation retains its lifecycle. Independently rebuilding and substituting the prior browser bundle reproduces all 13 prior renderer hashes and byte counts and both script wrapper hashes.

mutation_receipt_review.reviewed_change: Validate the fields consumed from successful profile, OAuth and Skill mutation receipts before continuing. Incomplete receipts use the existing refresh-required recovery without replaying writes. Independently rebuilding the source-base browser bundle reproduces all 13 prior renderer hashes and byte counts and both script wrapper hashes; substituting only that bundle restores every prior output.

runner_remote_update_review.reviewed_change: Queue immutable signed version operations, accept exact development versions, display localized host-manager progress and preserve operation identity in the version form. Only runner-detail markup changes.

runner_remote_update_copy_review.reviewed_change: Use the Runner version heading and one sentence describing latest or exact version selection. Substituting only these two text changes reproduces the previous byte count and hash.

console_ui_review.reviewed_change: Reviewed persistent sidebar navigation, shared style modules, resource-first lists, grouped management actions, prioritized Runner version controls, accessible table headings and two-line timestamps. Existing form actions, fields, CSRF and translation annotations were compared by renderer and browser checks.
